description_en: Taṃcāis a vernacular term meaning a 'slope'. The Bāhāḥ (also known as Jetavarṇa Mahāvihāra in Sanskrit) gets its vernacular name as it stands by a street that goes downhill (taṃcā).  The three-storykvāḥpāḥchẽof the Bāhāḥ faces north. Originally, thekvāḥpāḥchẽwas built in a traditional Newar style, but it was replaced by a concrete structure after its reconstruction in 2011 CE. The ground and first floor of the Bāhāḥ house itsāgaṃand sanctum, respectively. Previously, the main entrance to the sanctum was flanked by various large wall paintings, but only images of Sāriputra and Maudagalyāyana were painted after the above-mentioned reconstruction. A woodentoraṇa(on which an image of Akṣobhya is depicted as the central deity) caps the entrance. The sanctum houses a Buddha statue in thebhaviṣyavyākaraṇamudrā(Maitreya) as the main deity of the Bāhāḥ. Aśikharakūṭacaityais established at the Bāhāḥ premises. Usually, acaityastands right in front of thebāhāḥ'skvāḥpāḥdyaḥ. However, thiscaityahere stands slightly to the east of the main deity.There are no historical sources to date the initial construction of the Taṃcākone Bāhāḥ. Its members state that they had originally moved to Bhaktapur from the Taḥchẽ Bāhāḥ (KAT0470), Kathmandu and built a separatebāhāḥhere. Due to the poor condition of the building, they rebuilt thekvāḥpāḥchẽby collecting donations from thesaṃghamembers.The lineage deity of the Bāhāḥ members is Guhyeśvarī, an esoteric deity whose main shrine is in Kathmandu. However, her essence was brought to Bhaktapur and enshrined at Siddhapokhari for the convenience of the Bāhāḥ members. They take a turn for a year to perform daily rituals here. Every year on the full moon day of Āśvina, achatraused to be offered to the above-mentionedcaityaat the Bāhāḥ premises. This tradition has been discontinued for past few years. Previously, aspecial worship used to take place here also at the time of an eclipse. This tradition too has been discontinued.
description_ne: इटाछेँ टोलको ओरालोमा बनाइएको हुनाले यस बाहाःको नाम तंचाकोने बाहाः रहन गएको हो । संस्कृतमा यस बाहाःलाई जेतवर्ण महाविहार भनिएको छ । यो नाम कसरी रहन गयो भन्ने कुरा थाहा पाइँदैन । बाहाःको क्वाःपाःछेँ उत्तराभिमुख गरी तीन तलाको बनाइएको छ । पहिले परमपरागत रूपमा नेवारी शैलीमै क्वाःपाःछेँ बनाइएको थियो, पछि पुनर्निर्माण गर्दा आधुनिक शैलीमा ढलान गरिएको छ । क्वाःपाःछेँको पहिलो तलामा आगम स्थापना गरिएको छ । भुइँतलामा बाहाःको गर्भगृह रहेको छ । पहिले गर्भगृहभित्र प्रवेश गर्ने ढोकाको दायाँबायाँ विभिन्न चित्रहरू बनाइएका थिए । पुनर्निर्माणपछि ढोकाको दायाँबायाँ सारिपुत्र र मौदगल्यायनको चित्र बनाइएको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र प्रवेश गर्ने ढोकामाथि अक्षोभ्य अङ्कित काष्ठ तोरण राखिएको छ । क्वाःपाःद्यःको रूपमा गर्भगृहभित्र भविष्यव्याकरण मुद्रामा रहेका बुद्ध (मैत्रेय) स्थापना गरिएको छ । बाहाः प्राङ्गनमा नेसं ८२० (सन् १७००) मा स्थापना गरिएको शिखरकूट चैत्य रहेको छ । सामान्यतया क्वाःपाःद्यःको ठीक सामुन्ने चैत्य गरिन्छ तर यहाँ सामुन्ने नभई अलिकति पूर्वतिर चैत्य स्थापना गरिएको छ ।यस बाहाःको निर्माणकाल र निर्माताबारे कुनै ऐतिहासिक प्रमाण प्राप्त भएको छैन । बाहाःका सदस्यहरूका अनुसार उनीहरू काठमाडौं तःछेँ बाहाः (KAT0470)बाट भक्तपुरमा आएर छुट्टै बाहाः बनाएर बसोबास गरेका थिए । बाहाःको क्वाःपाःछेँ जीर्ण भएर भत्केकोले संघ-सदस्यहरूसँग चन्दा उठाएर पुनर्निर्माण गरिएको थियो ।यस बाहाःको कुलदेवता गुह्येश्वरी हुन् । अहिले तन्त्रविद्याद्बाट तानेर सिद्धिपोखरीमा ल्याइएको छ । यहाँ बाहाःका संघसदस्यहरूले एक-एक वर्षको पालो मिलाएर नित्यपूजा गरिरहेका छन् । प्रत्येक वर्ष आश्विन शुक्ल पूर्णिमाको दिनमा बाहाः प्राङ्गनमा रहेको चैत्यमा छत्र चढाइन्छ । केही वर्ष अघिदेखि यो परम्परा बन्द भइसकेको छ । प्रत्येक वर्ष पौष कृष्ण १० को दिनमा बाहाःको आगममा दिसिपूजा मनाइन्छ । सूर्य ग्रहण वा चन्द्र ग्रहण लागेको दिनमा आगममा विशेष पूजा गरिन्छ । अहिले यो परम्परा पनि बन्द भइसकेको छ ।

historical_events.event_name: Initial construction of a caitya? (see object number BKT0580-004 above)
historical_events.event_description: Thecaityabears two inscriptions on its same façade. The first inscription mentions a date only. It is likely that this date refers to the initial construction of thecaitya. The second inscription is dealt with below.

This inscription was inscribed exactly one year later after the completion of the construction of thecaitya.Although the inscription does not record which event it refers to, it is very probable that the inscription was inscribed to record the first anniversary celebration of thecaitya.
Due to the poor condition of the building, thekvāḥpāḥchẽwas reconstructed by collecting donations from thesaṃghamembers. It lost its traditional Newar architecture during that reconstruction.
